tagline: Good food deserves another table, not a garbage bin.
disclaimer: Automated checks do not certify food safety. Real deployment requires professional, legal and public-health review.

landing.eyebrow: A safer path from surplus to support
landing.title: Rescue suitable food. Protect dignity. Act locally.
landing.intro: PlateBridge coordinates donors, community members, volunteers and trusted local partners before good food becomes waste.
landing.privacyText: Recipients use a public alias, approximate locations and collection points. Contact details stay private.
landing.pilot: Designed for a careful Galle pilot
landing.pilotText: Start with verified organisations, selected community partners, trained volunteers and defined collection points. Introduce households gradually.
